caseNameFull: S. D. Harper, in Error v. Grant Victor, United States Marshal, etc.
summary: In error to the Circuit Court of the United States for the Eastern District .of Oklahoma.
attorneys: Mr. Jas. S. Davenport for the plaintiff in error., The Attorney General and Mr. Assistant Attorney General Adkins for the defendant in error.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

Dismissed for the want of jurisdiction on the authority of Fisher v. Baker, 203 U. S. 174, 182, and cases cited, and cause remanded to the District Court of the United States for the Eastern District of Oklahoma.
